title: A Meat-Summer Night’s Dream: A Tangible Design Fiction Exploration of Eating Biohybrid Flying Robots
reasoning: The paper centers on exploring ethical and moral boundaries through a speculative design fiction. It includes extensive research and findings on 'Ethics and Moral Boundaries' (Section 4.1.2) and 'Edibility as a Negotiated Ethical Boundary' (Section 5.2), including participants' invocation of religious worldviews (e.g., the concept of the soul and Hindu sacred beliefs) as part of the study's qualitative evaluation.
